user.title: Basic Settings
user.description: Configure your virtual Fronius GEN24 inverter name and connection settings.

data_description.name: Used as the mDNS hostname (e.g. 'fronius-virtual' → fronius-virtual.local)
data_description.system_name: Shown in the Wattpilot pairing screen, e.g. 'MyHome'. Defaults to the inverter name if left blank.
data_description.port: Port for the Fronius Solar API HTTP server (default: 80)
data_description.update_interval: How often to refresh sensor values in seconds (default: 10)
data_description.modbus_enabled: Also emulate a Fronius Smart Meter IP via Modbus TCP — gives the Wattpilot a second way to receive grid data
data_description.modbus_port: Modbus TCP port (default: 502 — use 5020 if HA lacks permission to bind port 502)

grid.title: Grid Settings
grid.description: Map your electricity meter sensor to the grid power field. Enable 'Configure per-phase sensors' at the bottom if your meter provides per-phase data for improved Wattpilot load balancing.

data_description.p_grid_dual_mode: Enable if your meter provides separate import and export readings instead of a single signed value.
data_description.p_grid_sensor: Measures power at your electricity meter. Negative = exporting solar to grid, Positive = importing from grid.
data_description.p_grid_sensor_pos: Measures power being imported from the grid (positive values only). Used with dual sensor mode.
data_description.p_grid_sensor_neg: Measures power being exported to the grid (positive values only, will be treated as negative). Used with dual sensor mode.
data_description.p_grid_invert: Enable if your sensor reports export as positive — this will flip the sign.
data_description.grid_phases: Single phase for single-phase supply, three phase for 3-phase. Affects load balancing.
data_description.grid_ct_rating: Main circuit breaker rating in amps — Wattpilot uses this to prevent overloading. Default: 32A. Can also be set directly in the Solar.wattpilot app.
data_description.configure_per_phase: Show the next step to map per-phase power, current, voltage, power factor, and reactive power sensors. Only needed if your meter provides per-phase data.

generation.title: Solar & Battery
generation.description: Map your solar generation, battery, and house load sensors. All fields are optional — leave blank if not available.

data_description.p_pv_sensor: Measures total solar panel output in watts. Should always be a positive value.
data_description.p_pv_invert: Enable if your solar sensor reports negative values during generation.
data_description.p_akku_dual_mode: Enable if your battery reports charge and discharge as separate positive-value sensors.
data_description.p_akku_sensor: Measures battery charge/discharge power. Positive = charging, Negative = discharging.
data_description.p_akku_sensor_pos: Measures power going into the battery (positive values only).
data_description.p_akku_sensor_neg: Measures power coming out of the battery (positive values only, will be treated as negative).
data_description.p_akku_invert: Enable if your battery sensor sign is reversed.
data_description.p_load_sensor: Measures total household power consumption. Should be a negative value.
data_description.p_load_invert: Enable if your consumption sensor reports positive values.
data_description.soc_sensor: Reports battery percentage from 0–100%. Used by the Wattpilot for battery threshold charging decisions.

advanced.title: Per-Phase Load Balancing
advanced.description: Optional per-phase sensors for improved Wattpilot load balancing accuracy. Leave blank for any sensors your meter does not provide — values will be derived automatically.

data_description.p_grid_phase_a: Per-phase grid power for load balancing. Leave blank to auto-split total P_Grid equally across phases.
data_description.p_grid_phase_b: 3-phase only. Leave blank if not available.
data_description.p_grid_phase_c: 3-phase only. Leave blank if not available.
data_description.i_grid_phase_a: Per-phase grid current in amps. Use if your meter provides current rather than power. Can also be configured directly in the Solar.wattpilot app.
data_description.v_grid_phase_a: Optional. Defaults to 240V if not set. Only needed if your voltage varies significantly.
data_description.v_grid_phase_b: 3-phase only. Defaults to 240V if not set.
data_description.v_grid_phase_c: 3-phase only. Defaults to 240V if not set.
data_description.power_factor_phase_a: Optional. From your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
data_description.power_factor_phase_b: Optional. From your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
data_description.power_factor_phase_c: Optional. From your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
data_description.q_grid_phase_a: Optional. From your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
data_description.q_grid_phase_b: Optional. From your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
data_description.q_grid_phase_c: Optional. From your Smart Meter. Improves load balancing accuracy.
